card.name: Linking words before a following noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "by", "inside" or "already" in running prose, where a specific noun phrase is expected next. Also the start of "endophthalmitis" after "suggestive of".

modes.label: Of after start/end/letter
modes.description: The word "of" after a noun like start, end or letter, before a named thing.
modes.example: Researchers will also use the start<< of>> the mission to get themselves acclimated

modes.label: Start of endophthalmitis
modes.description: The first piece of "endophthalmitis" after "suggestive of" in injection warnings.
modes.example: patients should be instructed to report any symptoms suggestive of<< end>>ophthalmitis or retinal detachment

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Prepositions or adverbs such as "by", "inside" and "already" before a time or place phrase.
modes.example: Most South Dakotan children receive five pertussis vaccinations<< by>> the time they start kindergarten.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mixed Chinese and word-piece items and the suppressed ones are technology words.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words like "of" and "by" just before the noun they introduce.
